scenario: Stop llama, observe inference and authenticated backend behavior, verify no analysis persistence, restart llama, wait for readiness.
resource_note: After restart and model remapping, host available memory was 7.0 GiB and zram swap use was 1.2 GiB (up from about 104 MiB before the restart). Further model stress and the optional FastAPI restart test were stopped under the resource-safety rule.
conclusion: Runtime unavailability was explicit, bounded, non-persistent, and recoverable; no silent success fallback occurred.
